prompt:
Designed website UI screenshot of the KONSTANZ desktop home page, first viewport, 16:9 landscape browser chrome-free. A designed website, not a photograph of a newspaper, not a photo of a printed page, not a mockup sitting on a desk. Flat full-bleed browser viewport of a live website.

STRUCTURE top to bottom, scale relationships:

1. TOP NAV (thin, ~6% of viewport height): quiet paper nameplate bar. Left: wordmark KONSTANZ in small serious grotesque, tracking slightly open, ink #111111. Right of wordmark a thin vertical rule then nav links Discover, Explore, Weekend, Saved in the same grotesque at 13px, #5C564C, no icons, no underline except Weekend or Discover as current in #111111. No search field, no account, no ticket, no CTA button. Hairline rule under the nav in #5C564C at 20% opacity. Background #E7E1D4.

2. NEWSPAPER MASTHEAD (next ~18% of viewport): full-width nameplate like a German city weekly, not a magazine cover. Centered stacked: small-caps red #9B1D2A label “WOCHENENDE” at 11px, then KONSTANZ in a serious news grotesque (Akzidenz-Grotesk / News Gothic / Helvetica Neue Condensed character — NOT a high-contrast display serif, NOT Didot, NOT Playfair, NOT editorial fashion serif). Below the wordmark a single hairline, then a secondary line in small grotesque: “30 AUG · KONSTANZ · city culture listings” in #5C564C. Thin double-rule (two 1px ink lines) under the masthead. No decorative flourishes, no drop caps, no italic display.

3. THREE COLUMNS of listings (remaining ~76% of viewport) under small-caps section heads, newspaper column grid with 1px ink column rules between them. Equal column gutters. Background continuous newsprint #E7E1D4 with faint paper tooth, not a white web page.

LEFT COLUMN — small-caps head “FREITAG” in #9B1D2A, 11px, tracked. Under it listing blocks as type, not cards:
- Techno Friday / Blechnerei / Fri 23:00 / €8
Short one-line dek in #5C564C. Hairline under each listing.

CENTER COLUMN — small-caps head “SAMSTAG” in #9B1D2A. LEAD LISTING is Student Night: large listing occupying the upper two-thirds of this column. Headline “Student Night” in news grotesque, 28–32px, ink #111111, not a hero banner. Subline Club XYZ · Sat 22:00 · €5. A PHOTO STILL as a listing cut-in: a rectangular documentary club-night photograph (crowd, dim room, no neon UI) inset into the listing like a newspaper halftone, occupying maybe 40% of the lead listing width, flush left of the dek, NOT a full-bleed website hero, NOT a card image with rounded corners or drop shadow. Below the lead, a smaller listing: House Saturday / Kulturhaus. Hairlines, not cards.

RIGHT COLUMN — small-caps head “CLUB” in #9B1D2A. Listings as type:
- Live Music Night / Bar Central / Free
- Hip-Hop Party / Hafenbar
Same listing grammar: title, venue, time/price, one-line dek, hairline rules.

TYPE: serious German city-paper grotesque throughout (news gothic, not fashion serif). Small-caps ONLY for section heads FREITAG / SAMSTAG / CLUB and the WOCHENENDE kicker. Body and listings in grotesque. No high-contrast display serif. No editorial-AI magazine look.

PALETTE locked: page #E7E1D4 newsprint, type #111111 ink, section accents #9B1D2A, secondary #5C564C warm gray. Materials: newsprint, column rules, small-caps heads, ink black.

EXCLUSIONS: no search-hero banner, no card grid, no rounded event cards, no neon, no Eventbrite layout, no ticket buttons, no Sign in, no Create event, no profile avatar, no browser chrome, no phone frame, no stock-photo collage hero, no glowing UI, no drop shadows on cards, no white SaaS background.
